_doc: Transcribed from Nemotron-CC (arXiv 2412.02595v2, HTML) on 2026-10-15. Trillions of tokens. 'unique' = estimated tokens after global fuzzy deduplication of the real tokens.

quotes.intro: Both DCLM and FineWeb-Edu contain around 80% near-duplicates (1T and 0.2T unique tokens, respectively)
quotes.abstract: aggressive model-based filtering, but at the cost of removing 90% of data. This limits their suitability for long token horizon training, such as 15T tokens for Llama 3.1
quotes.appE: The first phase of 9T tokens used 59% English Common Crawl data (5.31T) and the second phase of 6T tokens used 31% (1.86T), for a combined total of 47.8% (7.17T). In the first phase, we used medium, medium-high, and high quality data (real and synthetic), and in the second phase we used only high quality data (real and synthetic).
quotes.sec3: swapping 4 out of 8 epochs of high-quality data with a mix of synthetic datasets improves accuracy on most benchmarks
quotes.table6: 8B trained for 15T tokens: MMLU 70.3 vs Llama 3.1 8B 65.3 (NVIDIA's own lm-evaluation-harness setup)
